notes.title: UPDATE 0.1.1.0a
notes.content: [h3]Content:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new Halloween-themed mask.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Canine Metamorphosis Potion.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Readability:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a blindfold to the [b]Forgotten Widow[/b] to help players better understand her game mechanic.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance:[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the [b]Doctor[/b]'s behavior: he is now less likely to camp a player hiding in a wardrobe.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a very rare case where a player killed right after a resurrection could become unable to move for the rest of the match.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [h3]Balance:[/h3][list][*][p]The price to unlock the West Wing has been reduced from [b]150[/b] to [b]100[/b] memory fragments.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the spray not working for clients in multiplayer sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing an orange screen to appear depending on the spectator camera height or during some cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Hunter couldn’t hit a player standing behind a door frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where entities could temporarily get stuck on an already open door.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the rune symbol preview from the Sealed Door Grimoire could remain visible if a player changed equipment while aiming at a door.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance:[/h3][list][*][p]Optimized loading to reduce RAM usage.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [h3]Doctor's house[/h3][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could leave the rat room without reverting to their normal form.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a synchronization issue with traps inside drawers in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the placement of some valuable items that could be unreachable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where walking in the rat room did not generate any footstep sounds.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [h3]New Features:[/h3][list][*][p]Solo players can now [b]exclude an entity[/b] from their run. [/p][/*][/list][h3]The Forsaken:[/h3][list][*][p]Added subtitles.[/p][/*][*][p]A new visual effect making her easier to locate.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.1.0.0a THE FIRST THIEF
notes.content: [p]Thank you all for your patience![/p][p]The time has finally come... we are thrilled to unveil our brand new update: "[b]The First Thief[/b]".[/p][p][/p][p]In this new chapter, dive once more into the depths of a memory...[/p][p]But this time, it’s different.[/p][p][/p][p]More complex, more demanding, and more dangerous.[/p][p]The entity lurking there has learned. It knows you. It’s waiting for you.[/p][p]And it doesn’t intend to let you leave.[/p][p]Do you have what it takes to face this challenge and uncover its mysteries?[/p][h3]New Features:[/h3][list][*][p]This level introduces a brand-new mechanic: using your reasoning is essential to reach your final goal.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a feature allowing you to whistle different musical notes in-game.[/p][/*][/list][h3]The Doctor:[/h3][list][*][p]The [b]Doctor’s[/b] domain is now open. A new face awaits, watching your every move.[/p][/*][*][p]The first team that dared venture there made the irreparable mistake. The one rule of thieves was broken.[/p][/*][*][p]Since then, the memory is forever altered unless you manage to seize the forgotten object.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cemetery:[/h3][list][*][p]The West Wing of the cemetery is now accessible![/p][/*][/list][h3]Codex:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new entry dedicated to the "[b]Doctor[/b]".[/p][/*][/list][h3]Connection System:[/h3][list][*][p]Improved session connection system.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Options:[/h3][list][*][p]Added an option to adjust in-game microphone volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to enable or disable subtitles.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where a player could remain stuck if reading a note at the moment of death and then revived before closing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Spectral Grasp curse can no longer catch a player while invisible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug resetting the FPS cap in the options menu at the start of each game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The First Thief[/b] is more than just an update. It’s a turning point. A test for the bold. A trap for the careless. A mystery to solve… or escape.[/p][p]Your move.[/p]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.15.1a
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] The Strangler can no longer push players when grabbing them.  
[*] Fixed a bug where, after returning to the main menu at the end of a match, the mask shown in the "Character" tab was incorrect.  
[*] Added the missing attribute "Spray Immunity" to the Nightmare's page in the Codex.  
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.15.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Customization:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] While waiting for more in-depth customization, we're offering a simple yet effective way to make your character feel more personal: you can now change their colors in the "Character" tab. Let your imagination run wild!  
[/list]  
[h2]Codex:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added small icons indicating the specific attributes of each entity in the Codex.  
[/list]  
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed a bug where Medusa was considered unseen when a player looked at her through a door frame.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the Magician’s kill sound could be heard throughout the entire level.  
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.14.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Magician:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] A new entity has appeared... and he’s got more than one trick up his sleeve.  
[/list]  
[h2]The Nightmare:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] The Nightmare is now temporarily banished after targeting its victim.  
[/list]  
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed a bug where using a defibrillator on a player during their death animation would consume it with no effect.  
[*] Fixed a bug in the generation of memory fragments that could cause some of them to be unreachable.  
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.13.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Hammers:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new type of equipment: hammers. They now allow you to collect memory fragments buried in the depths of memories.
[*] The first hammer can be obtained for free by existing players and is automatically granted to new players.
[/list]
[h2]Grimoire of Sealed Doors:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Grimoire of Sealed Doors can now be purchased in exchange for Memory Shards. It grants a mysterious power to those who can fully master it.
[/list]
[h2]The Forsaken:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the trigger radius of the Forsaken's initial call for help, providing a more balanced approach.
[/list]
[h2]Interface:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added tooltips when hovering over the icons of the game's various currencies to briefly explain their functions.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.12.3a
notes.content:
[h2]Memory Shard:[/h2] 
[list]
[*] A new currency is making its appearance... the Memory Shard. Rare and mysterious, no one has found a way to obtain it yet, but it's only a matter of time.
[/list]
[h2]Medusa:[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Medusa could not be blinded if a player shone a light on her back first.
[/list]
[h2]Doors:[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Players can now interact with open doors to close them.
[/list]
[h2]Nightmare:[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Nightmare could push players out of the map if it caug
ht them in a staircase.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.12.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Obscythe :[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Ancient basins called Obscythes, originating from another world, contain a magical liquid with properties as rare as they are powerful.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life :[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Added a button to expel a player from the team during a match.
[/list]
[h2]The Strangler :[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Strangler to strangle players through stairs.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.11.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Medusa[/h2]
[list]
[*] Medusa can no longer be petrified when she grabs a player.
[*] Medusa now properly disappears after petrifying a client player.
[*] Fixed a bug where Medusa did not properly play her blinding animation if a player tried to blind her repeatedly.
[/list]
[h2]The Forsaken[/h2]
[list]
[*] An old woman roams the world of memories in search of a selfless person… Will you be able to help her in time?
[/list]
[h2]The Forgotten Widow[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented her key from being visible after her cinematic was played.
[/list]
[h2]The Strangler[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could lock the player at the end of lockpicking when the entity interacted with them.
[/list]
[h2]Tesla[/h2]
[list]
[*] The charging time of the Tesla coils has been increased from 5s to 15s.
[*] The Tesla coil now removes half of your current equipment’s energy when it triggers, instead of emptying it completely.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a system that allows quick selection of equipment in-game.
[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected some spelling mistakes in French.
[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players who fall out of the map are now automatically teleported to the cemetery.
[*] Fixed a bug where entities, in certain cases, were not considered as seen by clients.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.10.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] The amount of experience gained per match has been increased to allow beginners to access new equipment more quickly.  
[*] Several gameplay elements now have a visual "shiny" effect to help players spot them more easily.  
[/list]  

[h3]Phone[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Slight increase in brightness for better visibility.  
[/list]  

[h3]Mystery Boxes[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Mysterious boxes have appeared in the world of memories... Will you dare to open them?  
[/list]  

[h3]Lockpicking[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] The lockpicking system is no longer affected by the refresh rate, making it smoother and more accessible.  
[*] Added a new, more durable lockpick that can be carried in greater quantities.  
[/list]  

[h3]Strangler[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] The Strangler now becomes invisible when not in contact with the ground.  
[*] Increased the volume of the Strangler's breathing to help players locate it more easily.  
[/list]  

[h3]Poisoned Baron[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] The Poisoned Baron is now correctly affected by sprays.  
[/list]  

[h3]Theodore[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] A strange teddy bear has appeared in the world of memories… Perhaps it’s best not to wake it.  
[/list]  

[h3]Lost Child[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] The Lost Child now correctly triggers the spray trap in the "safe zone" when attached to a player.  
[/list]  

[h3]Medusa[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Gameplay update: Medusa now behaves differently. A reread of the Codex is recommended to understand its new mechanics.  
[/list]  

[h2]General[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] TSR support has been discontinued.  
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.9.4a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Blue Orb[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the time needed to break the orb from 4s to 1.5s.
[/list]
[h3]Metamorphosis[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the player name position when in metamorphosis.
[*] Improved camera clipping.
[/list]
[h3]Nightmare[/h3]
[list]
[*] Has now been added to the Codex.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Outlines now appear when targeting a death player, even if there is no valuable item to steal.
[*] Player names are now displayed on the ground for death players.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck at the edge of the portal hole in the graveyard.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.9.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]  

[list]
[h3]Ritual[/h3]
[list]
[*] A mysterious ritual awaits you in this update. Will you manage to complete it and uncover all its secrets?  
[/list]
[h3]Blue orb[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new piece of equipment: the Blue Orb. When broken, it temporarily hides everyone nearby.  
[/list]
[h3]Forgotten Widow[/h3]
[list] 
[*] The Forgotten Widow is now slightly less oppressive for solo players.  
[/list]
[h3]Medusa[/h3]
[list] 
[*] Medusa's gameplay has been adjusted: she now grabs players one by one to eliminate them, preventing multi-kills. 
[*] Petrified players can now be resurrected once Medusa herself has been petrified.  
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.8.9a
notes.content:
[h2]Localization:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added the Italian translation.
[*] Added the Russian translation.
[*] Added the German translation.
[/list]

[h2]Corrections:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented a client from teleporting using the recall orb.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Drunkenness of the Abyss " curse music was not played.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Strangler to be invisible for certain configurations.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.8.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Removal of the Safe Zone on difficulty 3.
[h3]Forgotten Widow[/h3]
[list]
[*] She now detects you more easily when you’re carrying the child.
[*] She can no longer kill multiple players simultaneously.
[/list]
[h3]Alarm[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the time required to place it on the ground.
[*] Reduced the time before the alarm goes on.
[*] Affects the Forgotten Widow even when she is hunting.
[/list]
[h3]Exterminator Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Price reduced from 399 to 187.
[/list]
[h3]Green Raven Flower[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new flower has been added, granting poison immunity.
[/list]
[h3]Old Lantern[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new piece of equipment has been added: the Old Lantern.
[/list]
[h3]Recall Orb[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new piece of equipment has been added: the Recall Orb.
[/list]
[h3]Quill[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a system that allows you to access the “Summary” mid-game to see which items remain to be collected without having to complete the game.
[/list]
[h3]Nightmare[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rumor has it the Forgotten Widow has invoked an evil even more dreadful than herself.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added two new masks.
[*] Adjusted in-game voice chat attenuation for better audio balance and clearer communication.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to push AI while the alarm was equipped.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing certain keys from being picked up.
[*] Fixed a missing translation for the Red Raven Flower notification.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the hunter to kill a player through a wall.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the water pistol from affecting the Poisoned Baron.
[*] Fixed a bug causing a locked but empty drawer to appear in the ladder room.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.7.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Technical:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The game has been split into multiple files to reduce the size of future updates and patches. This results in a large download this time. We apologize for the inconvenience.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The legendary items of the Forgotten Widow and Medusa are now less easily accessible and will each require a trial. Will you dare to take the risk?
[/list]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have removed the letter "O" and the number "0" from lobby code generation.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Medusa could slide on the ground during her petrification.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Forgotten Widow was sometimes unable to kill a player during its hunting phase.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the Forgotten Widow to teleport into the ladder room.
[*] Fixed an issue where the summary displayed an extra legendary item to collect.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the impostor to kill someone even while invisible.
[*] Fixed an issue where a door could cause the player to fall through the map.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the Forgotten Widow’s door inaccessible.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing certain drawers from appearing next to the ladder room.
[*] Adjusted the size of a note that was initially too small.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.6.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]

[list]
[h3]Exterminator Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Impose your rule in the world of memories with the Exterminator Gun, an even more aggressive and precise version than the spray, to purify your enemies with a masterful shot!
[/list]
[h3]Hunter[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "Hunter" now only appears starting from level 2 tombs.
[/list]
[h3]Lost Child[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "Lost Child" is now more present once it has appeared in a game.
[/list]
[h3]Entity Exterminator Spray[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the number of available sprays depending on the difficulty level.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] The ladder room is now 99.9% safe thanks to an ingenious device.
[*] Added a new curse: "Pestilence".
[*] Reduced camera rotation constraints, allowing you to look upward more freely.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to grab an object from a lower drawer while the upper drawer was being opened.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where a player could remain stuck for the entire game when lockpicking.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing some items from being recovered.
[*] Fixed an issue where small items could appear on the ground during level generation.
[*] Fixed the death animation selector so that it no longer always selects the forward death animation.
[*] Fixed an issue with interaction distance, which was previously excessively long when looking downward.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the imposter to open a door that normally requires a key.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.5.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay :[/h2]

[list]
[h3]Hunter[/h3]
[list]
[*] Get ready to face a new threat, an entity that relentlessly hunts its prey...
[/list]
[h3]Medusa[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the range of the scream from 4m to 3m.
[/list]
[h3]Precious Object Detector:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Price reduced from £1400 to £120.
[*] Energy consumption reduced from 3 units to 1.
[*] Modified the functionality of the device.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the time required to interact with the cemetery exit.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Fixes :[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a very rare issue where a player could become permanently stuck at the top of a ladder.
[*] Fixed an issue where the petrification animation would not trigger if the player was affected by "Spectral Seize."
[*] Fixed an issue where the objective display did not match the actual progress of the players.
[*] Resolved several issues related to player disconnections: the mask and flower now disappear correctly, and the spectator mode no longer remains stuck on a disconnected player.
[*] Corrected several French translations.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.4.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]

[list] 
[*] Add a one-of-a-kind weapon! With this new spray, neutralize your enemies and enjoy some peace of mind. (Don’t ask about its composition; it’s top secret.) 
[*] New discoveries in the world of memories! Three Unique Rooms have been added. Mysterious and inaccessible without their respective keys, they hold treasures of inestimable value. Can you find them?
[*] An interaction message now appears at the exit portal if the objective is achieved but not all players are present. 
[*] A player equipped with the defibrillator can no longer pick up valuable items. [/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list] 
[*] Fixed several issues where certain objects remained inaccessible in otherwise reachable areas. You can now collect these precious rewards. 
[*] Fixed the petrification animation that was not synchronized for all players. 
[*] Resolved a bug where certain notes appeared black. [/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.0.3.0a
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay :[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added the defibrillator, which allows you to bring another player back to life. This essential item is automatically equipped for all new players, while existing players will need to purchase it in the shop for 0£.
[*] Slight increase in the cooldown for the "Lost Child" transmission.
[*] Now, the "Lost Child" will release you if you are poisoned by the "Poisoned Baron," providing a new way to rid yourself of this little terror.
[*] Reduced the time required to interact with doors and drawers.
[*] Increased drawer opening speed.
[*] The contents of the strongbox are now always a legendary item.
[*] The impostor now only appears from level 2 graves onward.
[*] Reduced the price of the "Crowbar" from 4000£ to 1000£.
[*] Slight increase in the proximity chat range.
[*] If you lose a game, you now earn 25% of the value of all the items you managed to bring back to the van.[/list]

[h2]Fixes :[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed collision issues with a necklace that couldn’t be picked up from a shelf depending on map generation.
[/list]
